stands_for.caption: Grouped by Congress.gov's official policy area. Shows how they voted, not why. Final-passage, amendment, and procedural votes can mean different things; read the note for each.

said_voted.caption: Posts are shown as written. A post is matched to a vote only when it names the bill number or the bill's official title. A post can mention a bill for many reasons.

roll_calls.plain_language: H.R. 8365 (Monitor Accountability Act) requires the Administrative Office of the U.S. Courts to establish conditions on the appointment of monitors to oversee state and local governmental entities. A motion to recommit is the minority's last formal chance to send a bill back to committee before the passage vote. A Yea supports sending it back; a Nay keeps it on the floor for the passage vote.

roll_calls.question: On Passage — Monitor Accountability Act (H R 8365)
roll_calls.plain_language: This bill requires the Administrative Office of the U.S. Courts to establish conditions on the appointment of monitors to oversee state and local governmental entities. A Yea supports passing it in the House; a Nay opposes it.

post.text: I am pleased that this political distraction was, at least temporarily, slowed. I call upon our Republican leadership in Congress to immediately send bills to the President's desk that reflect the will of the American people, such as the Coercion and Sexual Abuse Free Environment Act (a bipartisan bill protecting children from online predators), the Monitor Accountability Act (also a bipartisan bill to set clear rules for courts' use of federal monitors), and the Colorado River Basin Infrastructure Act (necessary to preserve the Colorado River for all Basin states).

conflicts.caption: These are overlaps in public records, not evidence of a deal. Lobbying can be for or against a bill, and donors' employers didn't necessarily give money.
conflicts.method: Each itemized donor dollar is counted once, under the industry of the donor's self-reported employer; an industry counts if at least one LD-2 client in it lobbied on any bill this member sponsored or voted on.
